scene: You step off the garden escalator into the glowing Moonlight Roller Garden.
picture: A flat side view under a dark starry sky. On the far left stands the brass garden escalator. To its right is a musical fountain spouting liquid notes. The player in lilac headscarf, mustard coat, and brown satchel stands centre-left, facing a roller-skating gardener mid-stride, beside a glowing flowerbed on the far right.
shown: a bubbling tier fountain spraying notes into the air on the left
a gardener in neon overalls coasting on roller blades at the centre
a raised planter of pulsating blue chrysanthemums on the far right

variants.scene: The escalator delivers you to a sparkling terrace filled with luminous blooms and music.
Glowing notes chime in the air, humming softly just like {tune}.
Neon lights twinkle over the smooth skating rink beside shimmering fountain waters.
